description: Add a non-root user and switch to it after running root commands. Use 'USER <non-root-user>' after executing necessary root operations. Ensure the user has appropriate permissions for the application to run.

example.after:
FROM node:16-alpine
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -g 1001 nodejs
RUN adduser -D -u 1001 nodejs
# Install dependencies and build app as root
RUN npm install
# Switch to non-root user
USER nodejs
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["npm", "start"]

fix_pattern.instructions: Add a non-root user and switch to it after running root commands. Use 'USER <non-root-user>' after executing necessary root operations. Ensure the user has appropriate permissions for the application to run.
